name: PND3D Octree Rendering
definition: A volume rendering method using a standard 8-way octree where non-leaf nodes are 64-bit structures containing child and solid masks, visited in front-to-back depth-first order to enable occlusion culling.
summary: PND3D Octree Rendering is a volume rendering method that splits the screen into tiles based on vanishing points to enable independent multithreaded processing and efficient occlusion culling.
